001package com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ghosts.types;
002
003import java.util.ArrayList;
004import java.util.List;
005
006import org.lwjgl.util.vector.Vector2f;
007
008import com.fs.starfarer.api.Global;
009import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.CampaignFleetAPI;
010import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.SectorEntityToken;
011import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ghosts.BaseSensorGhostCreator;
012import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ghosts.GhostFrequencies;
013import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ghosts.SensorGhost;
014import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ghosts.SensorGhostManager;
015
016public class StormTricksterGhostCreator extends BaseSensorGhostCreator {
017
018        @Override
019        public List<SensorGhost> createGhost(SensorGhostManager manager) {
020                if (!Global.getSector().getCurrentLocation().isHyperspace()) return null;
021                CampaignFleetAPI pf = Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet();
022                
023                Vector2f loc = findDeepHyperspaceArea(pf.getLocation(), 2000f, 3000f, 1500f, manager.getRandom());
024                if (loc == null) return null;
025                
026                SectorEntityToken target = Global.getSector().getHyperspace().createToken(loc);
027                
028                List<SensorGhost> result = new ArrayList<SensorGhost>();
029                SensorGhost g = new StormTricksterGhost(manager, target);
030                if (g.isCreationFailed()) return null;
031                result.add(g);
032                return result;
033        }
034
035        @Override
036        public float getFrequency(SensorGhostManager manager) {
037                return GhostFrequencies.getStormTricksterFrequency(manager);
038                //return 10000f;
039        }
040        
041        
042}
